tasks.title: Project Repository Setup
tasks.description: Set up the project repository with initial structure, build tools, and dependency management.
tasks.details: Initialize a Git repository. Configure build tools (e.g., Webpack, Babel for frontend; tsc for backend). Set up package managers (npm/yarn). Define initial project structure for frontend (TypeScript, React, Next.js) and backend (TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the repository is created, build tools are configured correctly, and dependencies can be installed.

tasks.title: Backend Core Infrastructure Setup
tasks.description: Set up the core backend infrastructure using Node.js and NestJS.
tasks.details: Initialize a NestJS project. Configure basic server setup, including middleware for request parsing and error handling. Set up logging and monitoring frameworks.
tasks.testStrategy: Ensure the backend server starts without errors and basic endpoints are accessible.

tasks.title: Frontend Core Infrastructure Setup
tasks.description: Set up the core frontend infrastructure using TypeScript, React, and Next.js.
tasks.details: Initialize a Next.js project with TypeScript. Configure basic routing and project structure. Integrate Tailwind CSS for styling and shadcn/ui for UI components.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the frontend application builds and runs, and basic pages are rendered correctly with the chosen UI library.

tasks.title: Database Schema Implementation
tasks.description: Implement the database schema for core entities using Prisma and PostgreSQL.
tasks.details: Define Prisma schema for User, Company, Request, RequestFile, Contractor, DocumentTemplate, TariffPlan, Payment, Notification, ChatMessage, and AuditLog entities. Apply migrations to create tables in the PostgreSQL database.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the database tables are created with the correct schema and relationships.

tasks.title: Entrepreneur Registration
tasks.description: Implement the basic user registration functionality for Entrepreneurs.
tasks.details: Create backend API endpoint for user registration. Implement logic to create a new User and Company entry in the database. Use bcrypt/Argon2id for password hashing. Implement frontend form using React Hook Form with Zod for validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Test successful registration with valid data and verify user and company entries in the database. Test with invalid data to ensure proper error handling.

tasks.title: User Authentication
tasks.description: Implement user authentication using JWT and Passport.js.
tasks.details: Implement backend API endpoints for login. Generate and verify JWT tokens using Passport.js. Implement frontend login form and handle token storage (e.g., in cookies or local storage).
tasks.testStrategy: Test successful login with valid credentials and verify token generation. Test with invalid credentials to ensure authentication failure.

tasks.title: Role-Based Access Control
tasks.description: Implement role-based access control (RBAC) for different user roles.
tasks.details: Define roles (Предприниматель, Сотрудник Компании Клиента, Консьерж-менеджер, Администратор Платформы). Implement middleware or guards in NestJS to protect routes based on user roles. Store user roles in the database.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that users with different roles can only access authorized resources and are denied access to unauthorized resources.

tasks.title: User and Company Profile Management
tasks.description: Implement user and company profile management.
tasks.details: Create backend API endpoints to view and update user and company profiles. Implement frontend forms for profile editing. Ensure only authorized users can update profiles.
tasks.testStrategy: Test viewing and updating profiles for different user roles. Verify data consistency in the database.

tasks.title: Employee Management
tasks.description: Implement the ability for Entrepreneurs to manage their company's employees.
tasks.details: Create backend API endpoints for inviting, adding, and managing employees associated with a company. Implement frontend interface for Entrepreneurs to manage employees. Ensure proper authorization.
tasks.testStrategy: Test inviting and adding employees as an Entrepreneur. Verify that employees are associated with the correct company and have appropriate roles.

tasks.title: Request Management (Client Side)
tasks.description: Implement the core functionality for creating and managing requests.
tasks.details: Create backend API endpoints for creating new requests and viewing existing requests for a user/company. Implement frontend interface for users to create requests and view their request list with statuses.
tasks.testStrategy: Test creating new requests with different data. Verify that requests are saved in the database and displayed correctly in the user's request list.

tasks.title: Request Management (Concierge Side)
tasks.description: Implement the interface for Concierge Managers to manage client requests.
tasks.details: Create backend API endpoints for Concierge Managers to view, update status, and assign requests. Implement frontend interface for Concierge Managers to manage the request queue.
tasks.testStrategy: Test viewing, updating status, and assigning requests as a Concierge Manager. Verify that changes are reflected in the database and visible to the client.

tasks.title: Request Chat System
tasks.description: Implement the internal chat system for communication related to requests.
tasks.details: Implement backend API endpoints for sending and receiving chat messages associated with a request. Use WebSockets or a similar technology for real-time communication. Implement frontend chat interface within the request details view.
tasks.testStrategy: Test sending and receiving messages between clients and Concierge Managers within a request. Verify that messages are stored and displayed correctly.

tasks.title: Tariff and Subscription Management
tasks.description: Implement the module for managing tariff plans and subscriptions.
tasks.details: Create backend API endpoints for defining tariff plans and managing user subscriptions. Implement database schema for TariffPlan and user subscriptions. Implement frontend interface for viewing tariff plans and managing subscriptions.
tasks.testStrategy: Test creating and managing tariff plans as an administrator. Test subscribing and managing subscriptions as a user. Verify data consistency in the database.

tasks.title: Payment Module Integration
tasks.description: Implement the payment module with integration for processing payments.
tasks.details: Integrate with a payment gateway (details not specified, assume a placeholder integration for now). Implement backend API endpoints for initiating and processing payments for subscriptions and one-time services. Implement frontend payment flow.
tasks.testStrategy: Test initiating and processing payments through the integrated gateway (using test credentials). Verify that payment records are created in the database and linked to users/subscriptions.

tasks.title: Notification System
tasks.description: Implement the system for sending and managing notifications.
tasks.details: Implement backend service for generating and sending notifications (in-app and email). Use Nodemailer with SendGrid/Mailgun for email sending and React-email for email templates. Implement database schema for notifications. Implement frontend interface for viewing in-app notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Test sending different types of notifications (e.g., new request, status update). Verify that notifications are sent via email and appear in the in-app notification list.
